meta.title: Prompt Forge
meta.description: One Prompt button beside the composer: its panel rewrites the draft into an executable prompt by a prompt-engineering doctrine, lists only the unknowns you have not considered, or edits the plugin's own settings (temperature, ask-first, rules file — live; the model always follows the conversation). Length and item count scale with the task. Answers come back as pickable rows, so you decide what replaces or extends the draft. The plugin is user-invoked only — no tools are exposed to agents.
